title: What Euphoria Character Am I?
description: Asking "what Euphoria character am I?" Answer 12 questions to find out which Euphoria character — Rue, Jules, Maddy, Cassie and more — matches your personality.

questions.text: Jules texts you about a last-minute party across town tonight. You...

options.text: Say yes instantly and blow up the group chat getting everyone hyped
Want to go, but need an hour alone to recharge before facing a house full of people
Spend the whole night bouncing between groups, meeting half the party
Find one person and have one deep conversation in a corner all night

questions.text: It's the first day back at school after a long, messy summer. You...

options.text: Work the hallway hugging everyone and collecting all the gossip
Keep your headphones on and slide to class quietly
Organize the group lunch table before the bell even rings
Rehearse small talk in your head, saving energy for close friends

questions.text: After a huge fight with someone you love, you...

options.text: Need to talk it out loud immediately, in person if possible
Disappear to process alone before you say anything
Blow up their phone with voice notes until it's settled
Write down everything you feel and only share it when you're ready

questions.text: When things explode inside your friend group, you...

options.text: Deal with exactly what's in front of you, one concrete problem at a time
Look for the deeper pattern underneath all the drama
Trust what people actually do, not what they might secretly mean
Read between every line — sometimes into stories that aren't there

questions.text: Reality gets too heavy and you need an escape. You reach for...

options.text: Something real and physical: a late-night drive, a snack run, a familiar place
A whole fantasy world you build in your head about who you could be
Rewatching moments and shows that already feel like home
Dreaming up an entirely new identity for yourself

questions.text: You're recounting last weekend's chaos to someone. You...

options.text: Give the exact facts in the order they actually happened
Turn it into a bigger story about what it all meant
Stick to what people really said and did
Connect it to old patterns running through your whole friend group

questions.text: A friend shows up at your door at 2am after a terrible decision. You...

options.text: Tell them plainly what they need to do to fix it
Hold them first — questions can wait
Walk through the consequences step by step so they see a way out
Tell them nothing they do could make you love them less

questions.text: Someone betrays you, then comes back with an apology. You decide on...

options.text: Whether their actions actually changed — not the words
How genuine the apology feels in your chest
Whether trust can realistically be rebuilt on evidence
How much you still genuinely care about them

questions.text: A fight breaks out in the group chat. You...

options.text: State your case with logic and refuse to sugarcoat it
Smooth it over so nobody gets hurt any worse
Point out exactly where people's reasoning doesn't add up
Message whoever seems most hurt and check on them privately

questions.text: Your life right now is best described as...

options.text: Planned: goals, routines, a vision you're executing
Open: whatever happens, you'll figure it out as you go
A list of things you're determined to achieve on a timeline
A chain of vibes and opportunities you chase as they appear

questions.text: When your whole world suddenly feels unstable, you...

options.text: Rebuild a routine fast and control everything you can
Ride the chaos until things start to become clear
Make strict rules for yourself and hold to them
Keep every option open — being locked down makes it worse

questions.text: By Friday afternoon, your weekend is...

options.text: Already booked around a solid plan
A blank page you'll fill entirely on instinct
Structured around the people and goals that matter most
Happening somewhere out there — and you'll find it

results.title: Jules Vaughn (ENFP)
results.description: Like Jules, you’re a vibrant, free-spirited soul who craves connection and self-expression. You see the beauty in everyone you meet, even the most broken parts. You’re unafraid to be your true self, even when it makes others uncomfortable. Your ENFP nature makes you creative, empathetic, and always chasing the next big adventure.

results.title: Maddy Perez (ENFJ)
results.description: You’re Maddy—confident, charismatic, and fiercely loyal to the people you love. You have a natural ability to lead and make others feel seen. You’re not afraid to stand up for what’s right, even if it means fighting against the odds. Your ENFJ heart makes you a protector, a cheerleader, and someone everyone wants in their corner.

results.title: Nate Jacobs (ENTJ)
results.description: Like Nate, you’re driven, strategic, and focused on getting what you want. You have a clear vision of your goals and will do whatever it takes to achieve them, even if it means stepping on others. You value control and efficiency, and you don’t let emotions cloud your judgment. Your ENTJ mindset makes you a powerful force, but you need to remember to soften around the edges.

results.title: Kat Hernandez (ENTP)
results.description: You’re Kat—witty, rebellious, and unapologetically bold. You love challenging the status quo and pushing boundaries to make people think. You’re quick with a comeback and always have a new idea up your sleeve. Your ENTP personality makes you a creative troublemaker who turns every situation into an opportunity to express yourself.

results.title: Cassie Howard (ESFP)
results.description: Like Cassie, you’re outgoing, energetic, and thrive in the spotlight. You live in the moment, always seeking new experiences and connections. You wear your heart on your sleeve and feel emotions deeply, which makes you both lovable and vulnerable. Your ESFP spirit makes you the life of the party, but you need to learn to prioritize your own needs over others’.

results.title: Lexi Howard (ESFJ)
results.description: You’re Lexi—caring, reliable, and always looking out for the people around you. You have a knack for remembering small details about others and making them feel special. You’re quiet but powerful, using your empathy and observation skills to bring people together. Your ESFJ nature makes you the glue of your friend group, the one everyone turns to for comfort and advice.

results.title: Cal Jacobs (ESTJ)
results.description: Like Cal, you’re practical, structured, and value tradition and order. You believe in following the rules and doing what’s expected of you, even if it means suppressing your own desires. You’re a provider who takes responsibility seriously, but you often struggle to connect with your emotional side. Your ESTJ mindset makes you dependable, but you need to learn to let go of control sometimes.

results.title: Fezco (ESTP)
results.description: You’re Fezco—calm, collected, and always ready to handle whatever life throws at you. You’re a problem-solver who thinks on his feet and uses his street smarts to get by. You’re fiercely loyal to your loved ones and will do anything to protect them. Your ESTP personality makes you a steady presence in chaos, someone who gets things done without fanfare.

results.title: Rue Bennett (INFP)
results.description: Like Rue, you’re a deeply feeling, introspective soul who sees the world through a lens of raw honesty. You struggle with balancing your desire to connect with others and your need to retreat into your own mind. You’re drawn to people who feel as deeply as you do, even if it means getting hurt along the way. Your INFP nature makes you empathetic, creative, and unapologetically authentic.

results.title: Ali Muhammad (INFJ)
results.description: You’re Ali—wise, intuitive, and have a gift for seeing the truth in people. You’ve been through your own share of pain, which makes you a compassionate listener and mentor. You have a strong sense of purpose and want to help others find their way. Your INFJ spirit makes you a quiet guide, someone who can see the light even in the darkest moments.

results.title: Elliot (INTJ)
results.description: Like Elliot, you’re mysterious, analytical, and always thinking several steps ahead. You keep your guard up, but once you let someone in, you’re fiercely loyal. You value honesty and authenticity, and you don’t have time for superficial interactions. Your INTJ mind makes you a deep thinker, someone who sees patterns others miss and uses them to navigate the world.

results.title: McKay (INTP)
results.description: You’re McKay—quiet, thoughtful, and focused on understanding the world around you. You often feel like an outsider, watching life from the sidelines rather than jumping in. You value logic and reason, and you struggle with expressing your emotions openly. Your INTP personality makes you a deep diver into the things you care about, but you need to learn to let people in more.

results.title: Gia Bennett (ISFP)
results.description: Like Gia, you’re gentle, artistic, and have a quiet strength about you. You express yourself through creativity, whether it’s drawing, dancing, or music. You’re sensitive to the world around you and prefer to avoid conflict. Your ISFP nature makes you a kind, peaceful presence, someone who brings beauty to every space they enter.

results.title: Suze Howard (ISFJ)
results.description: You’re Suze—nurturing, selfless, and always putting your family first. You have a warm, welcoming energy that makes everyone feel at home. You remember every birthday, every favorite meal, and every little detail that matters to the people you love. Your ISFJ heart makes you the ultimate caregiver, someone who loves deeply and shows it through actions.

results.title: Leslie Bennett (ISTJ)
results.description: Like Leslie, you’re responsible, hardworking, and committed to doing what’s best for your family. You have a no-nonsense approach to life, focusing on practical solutions rather than emotional indulgence. You struggle to understand when others don’t see things your way, but you love fiercely underneath it all. Your ISTJ mindset makes you a rock, someone who keeps things together when the world falls apart.

results.title: Ash (ISTP)
results.description: You’re Ash—quiet, observant, and incredibly skilled at what you do. You prefer to let your actions speak for themselves rather than talking about your abilities. You’re calm under pressure and can fix almost anything with your hands. Your ISTP personality makes you a reliable problem-solver, someone who stays cool when everyone else is panicking.

share_hook: Ever wonder which Euphoria archetype you'd embody? Most people guess wrong on the first try, and the result usually sparks a fun conversation.
